description: This file serves as a user management PHP script for the TestLink project. It handles user information display, updating user details, changing passwords, generating API keys, session management, and rendering templates. It interacts with a database and utilizes various auxiliary classes and functions for user management.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: A class representing a user in the system, with methods for reading and writing user data, password management, and rights verification.

classes.name: APIKey
classes.description: A class responsible for creating and managing API keys for users.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A wrapper around the Smarty template engine for rendering views.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes input arguments from POST and REQUEST, returning an object with user parameters.

methods.name: changePassword
methods.description: Validates current password and updates to a new password for a user object.

methods.name: generateAPIKey
methods.description: Generates a new API key for a user and logs the event.

methods.name: checkDoAction
methods.description: Validates if the provided action is among the allowed actions.
